methodologyNotes: Covers standalone LED horticultural grow-light fixtures for indoor and greenhouse cultivation, sold at a published US price. Excludes fluorescent (T5) and HID/HPS/CMH fixtures, replacement bulbs, LED strip or clip lamps marketed for houseplants, and bare DIY quantum-board kits. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for the fixture only (no separate controller). actualPowerW is rated wall power draw at 100% output in watts (AC). ppfUmolS is total photosynthetic photon flux across the 400-700nm PAR band in micromoles per second (manufacturer-rated total output, NOT canopy PPFD). efficacyUmolJ is photosynthetic photon efficacy (PPF divided by power) in micromoles per joule; higher is better. flowerFootprintFt is the manufacturer-recommended flowering/bloom coverage written as feet x feet (e.g. 4x4); the veg footprint is typically larger and is not listed here. spectrumType is an enum describing the fixed output spectrum: full-spectrum-white, white-plus-red, white-plus-red-farred, or tunable-multichannel. diodeCount is the total number of LED emitters (integer). dimmable is true if the fixture supports onboard, external 0-10V, or app dimming. inputVoltageRange is the accepted AC input range in volts, written min-max. formFactor is an enum: bar-array, quantum-board, foldable-bar, panel, or cob. ipRating is the ingress-protection rating (e.g. IP65), or none if the fixture is not rated. warrantyYears is the manufacturer warranty in years. weightKg is fixture weight in kilograms.

products.name: Spider Farmer SE5000
products.priceNote: Manufacturer spider-farmer.com lists the SE5000 LED (fixture-only option) at regular price $409.99 (on sale $329.99). Retailer LED Grow Lights Depot lists it at $399.99. Using manufacturer MSRP $409.99 for the fixture only.
products.provenance: The manufacturer page (spider-farmer.com, upgraded SE5000) confirmed model identity through its "Product Model: SE5000" specification table and listed PPF 1420 μmol/S, PPE 2.9 μmol/J, Power Draw 480W, Input AC100-277V, 0-10V dimming, 5-Year warranty, 6.62 kg net weight, Core Coverage 3x3 ft (flower) / Max Coverage 4x4 ft (veg), and a fixture-only regular price of $409.99 (sale $329.99). The LED Grow Lights Depot retailer page corroborated the same Bridgelux SE5000 at $399.99 with matching PPF 1420, PPE 2.9, 480W, 100-277V AC and 5-year warranty, plus a Total diodes count of 1296 not shown on the manufacturer page. Both pages describe the identical Bridgelux-platform SE5000 bar-array fixture, confirming this is the exact model and not a sibling (SE3000/SE4500/G5000); no IP rating is stated on either page.

products.provenance: The AC Infinity manufacturer page (source) confirmed the exact model — Product Name "IONFRAME EVO8", Product Model AC-IF8K, UPC 819137024076 — with 730 W wattage, 2688 total diodes, 5 x 5 ft flower coverage, 100-277V AC input, IP-65 rating, a 2-Year warranty, and a Samsung LM301H EVO white (3000K/5000K) + 660nm red + 730nm far-red spectrum; it listed no USD price (geolocated to €699,92). Hydrobuilder (corroboration, SKU AC-IF8K) confirmed the identical specs and explicitly labeled the output "Total PPF Output 2013 µmol/s" (the manufacturer mislabels the same 2013 figure as "PPFD"; physics confirms 2013 is total PPF, since as canopy PPFD it would imply an impossible ~6.4 µmol/J), listed "IP65 Rated" and a "2 Year" warranty, and priced the fixture at "Sale Price $886.77" (GrowAce lists $799). The per-diode "3.14 µmol/J" figure is explicitly single-diode efficiency, not fixture PPF/power, so efficacyUmolJ is left null; weight is given only in pounds (38.0 lb), so weightKg is null.
